scope: Startup and business law as dated rules, grouped by the domains a company crosses from formation to dissolution. Coverage began with the United States; United Kingdom rules (Companies Act 2006 filings, HMRC registration deadlines, the VAT threshold, the written statement, EMI notification) joined 2026-10-16, New Zealand rules (Companies Office incorporation and annual returns, Inland Revenue registrations and rates, KiwiSaver employer duties, employment-agreement and trial-period rules, the privacy-breach notification duty) joined 2026-10-23, Singapore rules (Companies Act 1967 filings, ACRA deadlines, IRAS and CPF registrations, the PDPA breach duty) joined 2026-10-23, Australian rules (Corporations Act 2001 registration and review filings, ABN/GST/PAYG registrations, the superannuation guarantee, Fair Work duties, Privacy Act thresholds and breach notification, the ESS start-up concession) joined 2026-10-23, South Korean rules (Commercial Act incorporation and registry filings, corporate tax and VAT deadlines, social-insurance registration, labor-law baselines, PIPA breach notification, foreign-investment thresholds) joined 2026-10-23, Hong Kong rules (Companies Ordinance incorporation, officer, registered-office, significant-controllers and annual-return duties, the business registration window, two-tiered profits tax rates, employer return duties, MPF enrolment, the continuous-contract test, the PDPO voluntary breach-notification position) joined 2026-10-23, Estonian rules (Commercial Code formation and annual-report filings, Commercial Register Act petition and contact-person rules, the distributed-profits income tax, the VAT threshold, employment-register and labor-law baselines, the e-residency digital identity, the Personal Data Protection Act national layer) joined 2026-10-23, and the EU data-protection rules ride in the privacy domain. Every committed rule appears in exactly the sub-areas that cover it; lib/founderOps.ts enforces the references and the maturity consistency.

maturity_grades.mapped: The recurring rules a startup hits in this sub-area are committed.
maturity_grades.partial: Some recurring rules are committed; the gaps field lists what is missing.
maturity_grades.unmapped: No rules committed yet; the gaps field lists the rules a startup hits first.

domains.name: Formation and corporate governance

Estonian memorandum-of-association and articles mechanics (Commercial Code §§ 138-139) and the notary track for founders without a usable digital signature
